before_phrasing: I can't physically do that in this build — I've got no hands or actuators for that.
after_phrasing: I can't physically do that — I've got no hands or body for it.
mechanism: extended physical-action detector to cover contact requests (hug/hand me/carry) and softened the honest reply (no 'in this build'/'actuators')
